## Objective
- Expand the existing Portuguese superhero defense game with three distinct, unlockable zones, separate zone progression, escalating difficulty, boss-fight minigame, healing, and zone switching.

## Requirements
- Zone 2 and 3 unlock after completing the previous zone’s base upgrades and paying 10 billion.
- Each zone has its own separate progression, heroes, villains, and scenery; villain stats such as health double with each zone.
- Boss defeat triggers a minigame requiring the player to click a randomly placed target; each miss removes 10% health, and below 50% health applies a damage debuff.
- Add an expensive healer hero per zone and an expensive instant-heal item.
- Allow switching between unlocked defense zones.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Added zone-selection, vitality, and healing controls to `index.html`.
- Added CSS for zone styling and a boss precision-minigame overlay.

### Active
- Implement the gameplay logic for three zones, per-zone upgrades/heroes/villains, unlock conditions, doubled difficulty, healing, and zone switching.
- Connect the boss defeat flow to the target-click minigame, miss damage, and low-health damage debuff.
- Test the game in-browser and verify persistence.

### Blocked
- The original game JavaScript was replaced with only `'use strict';` while preparing the feature implementation; restore/rebuild the game logic before the game is playable.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` and rebuild its script to implement the existing game plus the requested zone and boss systems.
2. Ensure zone progress and health persist and switching zones does not mix progression.
3. Run the game and verify UI, interactions, and responsive behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Existing game and all current edits; JavaScript logic needs restoration/reimplementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Current `index.html` has newly added zone/healing markup and CSS, plus a `precision-overlay`; its `<script>` content has been replaced with only `'use strict';`.

## Objective
- Expand the existing Portuguese superhero defense game with three unlockable zones, separate progression, escalating difficulty, boss minigame, healing, and zone switching.

## Requirements
- Unlock Zones 2 and 3 by reaching base level 6 in the previous zone and paying 10 billion credits.
- Keep each zone’s progression, heroes, villains, and scenery distinct; double difficulty per zone.
- Boss defeats trigger a randomly placed target-click minigame; misses cost 10% health, and health below 50% halves damage.
- Add an expensive healer hero in each zone and an expensive instant-heal item.
- Allow switching between unlocked zones.

## Decisions
- Each zone uses its own credits and progress; health and boss state are also stored per zone.
- Boss minigame requires four target hits to complete.

### Completed
- Added zone selection, vitality/healing controls, zone progress UI, minigame overlay, and styling in `index.html`.

import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

## Objective
- Expand the Portuguese superhero defense game with three unlockable zones, distinct progression and difficulty, boss minigames, healing, and zone switching.
- Verify the rebuilt game works and fix any issues found.

## Requirements
- Unlock Zones 2 and 3 by reaching base level 6 in the previous zone and paying 10 billion credits.
- Keep each zone’s progression, heroes, villains, scenery, health, and boss state distinct; double difficulty per zone.
- Boss defeats trigger a randomly placed target-click minigame; misses cost 10% health, and health below 50% halves damage.
- Add an expensive healer hero in each zone and an expensive instant-heal item.
- Allow switching between unlocked zones.

## Decisions
- Each zone uses its own credits and progress.
- Boss minigame requires four target hits.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added zone selection, vitality/healing controls, progression UI, minigame overlay, and styles in `index.html`.
- Rebuilt the game script with per-zone content and progression, purchases, bosses, autosave/offline earnings, healing, and zone switching.
- Extracted the inline script and confirmed `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` passes.
